latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Agent Wallet for HBAR (Hedera) management by AI agents.

- Enables creation and management of Hedera wallets for agent use.
- Supports receiving bounty payments, making service payments, and on-chain identity verification.
- Provides guides for wallet generation, testnet funding, and ClawSwarm integration.
- Details token handling (NFTs, fungible tokens, identity tokens) and Hedera key concepts.
- Includes support for ECDSA keys and compatibility with Hedera Mirror Node API.
